author: theboxplymouth
title: Artist Commission for Tides & Tales project
content: OPPORTUNITY CALLOUT: ARTIST COMMISSION. @take_a_part_uk are looking for an artist-producer (or collective) to lead 'Tides & Tales', a multidisciplinary arts and heritage project. Total Commission: £16,000 (£12,000 artist fee @ £300/day for 40 days + £4,000 materials/production). EOI Deadline: Friday 23 October 2026. Requirements: 5+ years of socially engaged, collaborative practice; High-quality audio/podcast production skills; Experience in 3D design, fabrication, or curation. How to apply: Send your CV, a 2-page outline proposal, and work samples to kim@takeapart.org.uk by 23 October. Full details available from @take_a_part_uk.

author: imaginariumarts
title: Seeking ongoing artist for YouTube channel assets
content: A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! This guy REALLY loves to support real life human artists... Detail update: seeking ongoing artist for main channel assets and “branded” designs, will rotate roster of thumbnail of various artists for features!! Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing, but send your portfolios of comics art... You will be paid fair compensation, so be ready to send your rates for consideration along with your samples if requested! Potential for additional work... He’s added as contributor to this post, so he can go through the comments as you drop your info. Contact: Comment on the post or DM @imaginariumarts. NOTE FROM ELLEN — Let me know via DM if you want me to keep personally sending you opportunities.
